messages:
anya: Heads up — Customer NimbusLabs (acct 6142) reported two emails with invoices that have different totals but the same invoice_id. One includes a floating discount line, the other doesn't. Both went out.

tom-billing: I see it in render logs. renderer attempted twice for invoice_id INV-2026-06-02-6142; first attempt hung on discount calc, second attempt re-rendered and omitted discount lines because promo lookup returned empty on retry.

billing-bot: invoice-service: render_attempt=2 invoice_id=INV-2026-06-02-6142 status=sent duplicate_warning=true

anya: Customer paid the larger amount and is upset. We need to issue a credit if paid, void the wrong PDF, and reissue corrected invoice with discount applied.

olivia-cs: Customer is asking for an explanation and apology. Please confirm we will credit processing fees too.

raj-infra: Root cause suspicion: promo lookup service had transient 502 during first render attempt; retry path didn't rehydrate promo cache and renders without discount. Also renderer lacks idempotent line reconciliation so retry can produce inconsistent line sets.

tom-billing: quick SQL to check renders/payments:
```
SELECT r.attempt, i.invoice_id, i.total_cents, p.payment_id
FROM invoice_renders r
JOIN invoices i ON r.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
WHERE i.account_id = 6142 AND r.batch_date = '2026-06-02';
```

anya: Payment found: payment_id=pay_88b processed at 06:15 (matches higher total).

raj-infra: Mitigation plan: 1) pause automated resend for affected batch, 2) add idempotency reconciliation that compares existing invoice_lines for invoice_id and fails fast on mismatch, 3) re-run promo cache backfill and re-render for acct 6142, 4) issue credit memo for the delta and cover processing fee.

olivia-cs: Approved for credit memo and fee coverage. I'll send the customer note once finance confirms amount.

tom-billing: queued manual regenerate for INV-2026-06-02-6142 with --rehydrate-promos. billing-bot: regen queued job=regen-2026-06-02-6142 requested_by=tom-billing ETA=4m

billing-bot: regen completed job=regen-2026-06-02-6142 status=completed results: invoice corrected, credit_memo=CM-2026-06-02-6142 amount=1520 cents processed=true

anya: Confirmed corrected PDF contains discount line and single invoice. Credit memo issued and CS notified. Closing loop and filing FIN-INV-379.

raj-infra: I'll open a hotfix PR to add promo cache retry & renderer idempotency checks. Also adding an integration test for promo lookup failures.

tom-billing: PR https://git.redwood.internal/p/billing/+/3456 opened. Thanks team. Closing thread.
